A separately commissioned bounded correction completed cleanly under frozen WFC authority -- implementation followed by a fresh independent review accepting with zero findings -- further broadening the exercised route/failure-mode coverage this concern tracks.

The implementation is present but not independently accepted: carried requirement R1A is still open.

Four attempt lineages in which independent rereview repeatedly found real publication/provenance defects; positive evidence that the review loop bites, and the origin of the correction-loop carryover concern.

Four independently accepted slices implemented through self-development Runs, plus a post-acceptance out-of-band assurance review that found further material defects an accepted slice had carried -- broadening both the exercised routes and the known limits of one review pass.

Removes the largest mechanical operator cost -- hand-authored PREPARE/LAUNCH shell blocks -- without adding semantic authority. It does not touch Commission authoring, which the friction evidence identifies as the dominant remaining cost.
Deterministic pinning, cleanliness, PATH and provider-free preflight checks now execute identically every Run instead of being retyped, removing a recurring substrate-mistake class.
P1 delivered the selection seam and persisted contract identity with no semantic change to any admitted profile, and was promoted to Runtime.

Second independent reproduction of the finding-authority composition defect: the Run that implemented P1 could not complete its own lifecycle, and was unblocked only by an ad hoc per-Commission authority grant.
P2 made the worker and review result families genuinely distinct types with disjoint strict provider schemas, eliminating the S4-001 category mistake by construction.

Three non-accepting Runs whose cause an independent audit localized to Commission/profile topology rather than implementation, environment, or model quality; the corrected topology then completed in two Hops.
Shows the friction is not inherent to multi-Hop execution: the same work became operationally simple once the Commission accurately encoded the intended semantics.
Turns the evidence-placement half of the Commission-coherence failure class into a mechanical pre-provider admission refusal (DEC-WFC-012), leaving the authority-composition half open.
Run A's H003 architecture-test stop is the empirical trigger for treating architecture disposition as a Level-1 concern rather than something an ordinary correction worker may decide.

Demonstrated the intended trusted-evidence topology against the engine itself: semantic review acceptance did not complete the Run when Coordinator-owned evidence failed, and the declared failure route moved execution into correction.
A clean two-Hop implement-plus-fresh-independent-review acceptance with trusted evidence PASS and no Findings; also the commit currently promoted as Runtime.

Canonicalizes the maintainer-owned alternative to any automatic recovery: four explicit outcomes, exact-preservation verification, and a fresh separately authorized successor. It adds no WFC mechanism and deliberately keeps CandidateSnapshot outside the product.
The record wave that defines the current Level-0/Level-1 split and the candidate Level-1 duty list; everything in it is non-authorizing.
Keeps the stop-handling and successor-authorization duties above Level 0 in records that still assume a supervised caller; none of it closes the caller-mediation boundary.
The P3 slice is commissioned but not implemented: its only Run stopped after one Hop and the WorkItem remains open. This is what the next delivery decision in this concern is about.

Positive evidence for the Level-0 authority boundary: the worker discovered that an explicitly withheld file was required, and escalated instead of widening its own scope. It is not evidence of WorkItem completion.

Three separate Commission-coherence failures in one session: a persona byte overflow, required evidence on a non-gate worker phase (an invariant accepted days earlier), and a semantically incorrect withheld-file boundary that no renderer or validator would have caught.
The concentrated friction case: substantial pre-Run curation, two provider-free PREPARE repairs, a consumed attempt identifier, and then an immediate return of control to the human.
The record this concern exists to steward; it preserves the evidence, names the hypotheses, and lists the baseline metrics to capture before any redesign.
Prices the Commission-authoring failure class: cross-file relationships, duplicated specification, and guardrails discovered only at PREPARE after a multi-minute LLM authoring cycle.
The reviewed and amended non-authorizing hypothesis that currently best describes the intended Level-1/Level-0 split, including the rejection of a new trust-bearing layer between them.

Names the sequencing consequence to watch: information-flow or model-eligibility policy must not be layered on today's un-pinned execution-binding transport, because such a policy makes the binding authority-bearing.

Restates caller mediation and mechanical authorship provenance as the two open preconditions for any unsupervised above-Level-0 actor, and makes explicit that an above-L0 assistant is admissible only because it has nothing to escalate with.

Supplies the measured underuse evidence (empty component selectors across 124 phases, 36 near-duplicate profiles, one path list written in four places) and the honest test: if Commission lines, duplicated declarations, preflight refusals, and consumed attempt identifiers do not fall, a compiler is renaming rather than reducing.

A clean two-Hop implement-plus-fresh-independent-review completion with trusted evidence PASS and zero Findings, this time exercising the fresh-successor-after-stop path rather than a first attempt.

Further counter-evidence that friction is not inherent to the loop itself: once the successor Commission was correctly scoped, the slice completed in two Hops with a clean accept.
A host-binding/substrate friction instance distinct from the Commission-authoring friction this concern mainly tracks: a stale executable pin consumed an attempt before any provider invocation.
